sites.name: Yen Bai
sites.desc: Billet casting and homogenising. Scrap and ingot in, extrusion billet out.

sites.name: Thanh Hoa
sites.desc: Die shop and the second press hall. Dies are cut, nitrided and corrected here.

sites.name: Nghe An
sites.desc: Fabrication and machining. CNC centres, thermal break assembly, battery tray welding.

sites.name: Quy Nhon
sites.desc: Anodising. Two lines, 10 to 25 microns, with the sealing tanks beside the port.

sites.name: Binh Duong
sites.desc: The main press hall, powder coating, final inspection and container loading.

lede: Five factories take billet to finished profile, spread the length of the country from the northern casting lines to the export packing halls in the south.
title: Five factories, one coastline.
